title: The Nameplate
subtitle: components, and match: fuzzy
description: A sword with a name on it. `components` names a `minecraft:custom_name` component — the value is a string holding the JSON the codec writes — and `match: fuzzy` asks a carried stack to have the data the task names rather than to be identical to it in every other respect. A plain iron sword does not count; one named The Keystone does, whatever its durability says.

`match: none` would ignore the data entirely, and `match: strict` (the default, shown on the warrant beside this) would need the whole stack to agree. This task also declines the chapter's consume default, because a nameplate is not something the house gets to keep.
